name: National Merit Scholarship for Higher Education
description: Financial assistance for meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate studies.
benefits: Up to ₹12,000 per annum for tuition and maintenance allowance.
application_procedure: Apply online via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with required documents. Applications are verified by the institution before final approval.

eligibility_criteria.label: Must be a currently enrolled student
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000
Must have scored at least 60% in the previous qualifying exam

name: Rural Housing Assistance Scheme
description: Financial support to rural households for construction or renovation of a pucca house.
benefits: Up to ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas, disbursed in installments.
application_procedure: Apply through the local Gram Panchayat office or the official rural housing portal. A field verification is conducted before approval.

eligibility_criteria.label: Applicant must reside in a rural area
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,80,000
Applicant must not already own a pucca house

name: Disability Support Pension
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Monthly pension for persons with permanent disability who are unable to earn a livelihood.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month, credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
application_procedure: Apply at the district social welfare office or via the state e-governance portal with a valid disability certificate.

eligibility_criteria.label: Must hold a valid disability certificate (≥40% disability)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000
